import json, torch
from scripts.test_p106b_weight_route import Mini
from scripts import p106b_weight_route as r
torch.set_num_threads(1)
rows=[]
g=torch.tensor([[.7,-.2],[.3,.5]])
x0=torch.tensor([[.2,.9],[-.4,.6]])
for anneal in (0.,.37,1.):
 m=Mini(); m.set_anneal(anneal); w=m.a.weight.detach().clone(); x=x0.clone().requires_grad_(); m.refresh_quant(); effective=m.a._wq.detach().clone()
 (m.a(x)*g).sum().backward()
 aw=w.reshape(2,1,2).abs(); mask=(aw>=m.cfg.twn_thr_ratio*aw.mean(2,keepdim=True)).to(w.dtype); alpha=(aw*mask).sum(2,keepdim=True)/mask.sum(2,keepdim=True).clamp_min(1)
 window=(1/(1+(aw/(m.cfg.ste_clip*alpha).clamp_min(1e-8)).pow(4))).reshape_as(w)
 raw=g.T@x0; gx=g@effective; gw=raw*window
 torch.testing.assert_close(x.grad,gx,rtol=1e-6,atol=1e-7); torch.testing.assert_close(m.a.weight.grad,gw,rtol=1e-6,atol=1e-7)
 assert torch.equal(w,m.a.weight.detach())
 rows.append(dict(anneal=anneal,input_vjp_max_abs_error=float((x.grad-gx).abs().max()),weight_vjp_max_abs_error=float((m.a.weight.grad-gw).abs().max()),weight_vjp_identity_difference=float((m.a.weight.grad-raw).abs().max()),input_vjp_uses_interpolated_values=True,parameters_unchanged=True))
m=Mini(); x=x0.clone().requires_grad_(); w=m.a.weight.detach().clone()
with r.weight_route(m,'float'):
 m.refresh_quant(); (m.a(x)*g).sum().backward(); torch.testing.assert_close(x.grad,g@w,rtol=0,atol=0); torch.testing.assert_close(m.a.weight.grad,g.T@x0,rtol=0,atol=0)
print(json.dumps(dict(scope='synthetic CPU 2x2 VJP, no actual asset/model checkpoint/GPU/training/CP writes',rows=rows,float_identity_exact=True),ensure_ascii=False))
